title: PlantMetWiki BGC crosslinks: MIBiG and plantiSMASH to RDF
description: RDF Turtle files linking biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) data from MIBiG (curated) and plantiSMASH (predicted) to the PlantMetWiki / WikiPathways pathway knowledge graph, derived from PlantCyc 17.0. BGCs are typed as pmw:BiosyntheticGeneCluster and connected to pathway genes via RO:0000051 (has_part). For Arabidopsis thaliana, direct SPARQL joins are enabled through shared identifiers.org/tair.name/ IRIs. Includes VoID metadata, input gene-cluster membership JSON files, and a summary table of BGC–pathway gene crosslinks (199 unique links across 38 BGCs, 50 genes, and 109 metabolic pathways for Arabidopsis thaliana).
notes:
This dataset contains RDF representations of BGC data derived from three sources with different licenses:

1. MIBiG (curated BGCs): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0). Cite: Terlouw et al. 2023, doi:10.1093/nar/gkac1049.

2. plantiSMASH (predicted BGCs): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0). Cite: Kautsar et al. 2017, doi:10.1093/nar/gkx338.

3. PlantCyc 17.0 (pathway gene annotations used for crosslinks): OPEN DATABASE LICENSE FOR THE PLANT METABOLIC NETWORK DATABASES (PMN).
